artworks.title: The Anger of Achilles
artworks.description: David's Achilles at the moment of the false marriage — the bridegroom named in Agamemnon's lie when Iphigenia came to Aulis.

artworks.title: Iphigenia
artworks.description: La Fosse's altar at Aulis — Clytaemnestra's daughter weeping beside the hecatomb while Artemis held the winds.
